parameters.name: AlertLevel
parameters.description:
The alert notification level. Valid values:

- 0: no alert
- 1: reminder
- 2: suspicious
- 3: high-risk.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: FileOps
parameters.description: The list of operations performed on files.

parameters.name: FilePaths
parameters.description: The list of monitored file paths. Wildcards are supported.

parameters.name: FileTypes
parameters.description: The list of monitored file types.

parameters.name: Platform
parameters.description:
The operating system type. Valid values:

- **windows**: Windows.
- **linux**: Linux.

parameters.name: ProcPaths
parameters.description: The list of process monitoring paths. Wildcards are supported.

parameters.name: RuleAction
parameters.description:
The action to take when the policy is hit. Valid values:

- **monitor**: Alert.
- **block**: Block.
- **pass**: Allow.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the rule. Valid values:

- **0**: Disabled.
- **1**: Enabled.

parameters.name: SwitchId
parameters.description: The switch ID associated with the rule.
